decisions.reason: As a 2018 launch that had its own webpage in two consecutive years, this schlager compilation reflects enough sunk effort and visible commitment that management would likely continue it unless demand clearly collapsed.

Because this illustrated music release was presented as a distinct series on its own page, the firm has a stronger public and strategic commitment to justify, which lowers the likelihood of withdrawal.

This reissued jazz vinyl LP is a niche product, but its dedicated presentation and the collectible appeal of vinyl make management reasonably likely to keep it and attribute weak results to temporary market fluctuations.

A multi-disc box set typically involves substantial upfront preparation and signals prestige, so even if sales disappoint the firm is somewhat inclined to persist rather than admit the investment was misplaced.
Since this compilation CD was only mentioned rather than prominently featured, the firm's public commitment is weaker and it is the easiest product to remove if performance is underwhelming.
